## 📋 Estructura Interna del Archivo

### Clases definidas:

#### Clase `SimpleExtension` (Línea 14)
- **Docstring:** _Base class for a simple ISAPI extension_
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __init__(self)` (Línea 17): Sin docstring.
  - `def GetExtensionVersion(self, vi)` (Línea 20): Called by the ISAPI framework to get the extension version

The default implementation uses the classes docstring to
set the extension description.
  - `def HttpExtensionProc(self, control_block)` (Línea 29): Called by the ISAPI framework for each extension request.

sub-classes must provide an implementation for this method.
  - `def TerminateExtension(self, status)` (Línea 36): Called by the ISAPI framework as the extension terminates.

#### Clase `SimpleFilter` (Línea 41)
- **Docstring:** _Base class for a a simple ISAPI filter_
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __init__(self)` (Línea 46): Sin docstring.
  - `def GetFilterVersion(self, fv)` (Línea 49): Called by the ISAPI framework to get the extension version

The default implementation uses the classes docstring to
set the extension description, and uses the classes
filter_flags attribute to set the ISAPI filter flags - you
must specify filter_flags in your class.
  - `def HttpFilterProc(self, fc)` (Línea 64): Called by the ISAPI framework for each filter request.

sub-classes must provide an implementation for this method.
  - `def TerminateFilter(self, status)` (Línea 71): Called by the ISAPI framework as the filter terminates.
